bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest Bears story in the last 24 hours is the status of tight end Colston Loveland, who was ruled out for the remainder of Thursday's Thanksgiving game against the Lions after suffering a knee injury, with later reports indicating he is week-to-week and hopes to return by season's end. Sources reported Bears TE Colston Loveland is week-to-week with the knee issue, awaiting more tests , a notable blow for Chicago given the Bears were already thin at tight end after Cole Kmet sustained a season-ending knee injury earlier in the year .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions suffered a heartbreaking 39-35 Thanksgiving Day loss to the division-rival Chicago Bears at Ford Field, despite Jahmyr Gibbs officially setting a major NFL history mark, passing Barry Sanders , and a standout 313-yard performance from Jared Goff. The dramatic defeat snapped Detroit's momentum as the team now looks to "move forward" after the latest Thanksgiving heartbreak , while the Bears improved to 9-2 in a game that saw both teams dealing with key injuries on defense.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers fell to 6-5 after a 26-13 loss to the Los Angeles Rams on Thanksgiving Eve, their second straight defeat, with the offense badly missing injured receiver Christian Watson, who left the game with a concussion. Micah Parsons, who returned to action for the game, called the team's second-half performance "inexcusable" as frustration mounts over the Packers' fading playoff hopes.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings received discouraging injury news ahead of their Week 12 matchup with the Falcons, as head coach Kevin O'Connell confirmed wide receiver Jordan Addison, dealing with a thumb injury, is "progressing well" but is unlikely to play Sunday against the Falcons . This comes as the Vikings look to bounce back from a tough Week 11 loss to the 49ers, with the team now facing questions about O'Connell's job security and the direction of the roster heading into the stretch run.
